from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    dividers = [grid[horizontal[0]][0]]
    divider = dividers[0]
    rows = [r for r in horizontal if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in vertical if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    row_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for r in rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_ranges.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for c in cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_ranges.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    cells = [grid[r][c] for a, b in row_ranges for r in range(a, b) for x, y in col_ranges for c in range(x, y)]
    base = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for a, b in row_ranges:
        line = []
        for x, y in col_ranges:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != base for r in range(a, b) for c in range(x, y))
            line.append(1 if marks > 1 else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
